global_style: Minimalist, Morandi-inspired corporate presentation with high-contrast coral and teal color blocking, clean typography, and asymmetrical layouts.

identity_anchors: Thin, dual-color (coral/teal) vertical band permanently fixed to the left screen edge.
Solid rectangular highlight boxes placed directly behind specific heading words.
Sharp, unbordered, rectangular image crops with generous negative space.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
